newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys up to 17,500 tns term MTBE from SABIC.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys up to 17,500 tns term MTBE from SABIC.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded its six-month term tender to buy up to 17,500 tonnes of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) to petrochemical giant Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) of Saudi Arabia, industry sources said on Friday.
The tender closed October 29 and sought three to five cargoes of 3,500 tonnes of MTBE for delivery January to June 1997.
A CPC official said the award was at a discount of "several dollars" to the average of U.S. Gulf and North West Europe published spot assessments on a cost-and-freight basis to Taiwan.
"The range (of the discount) depends on the pattern of how CPC takes the cargo .. the quantity, the arrival of the cargo ... ," a SABIC trader said.
The trader did not give a range of the discount but said it was around the same level awarded for a tender for the second half of 1996, which SABIC did not win.
The trader also confirmed that SABIC had won the spot tender earlier this week to supply Taiwan with a 7,000 tonne cargo for December 1-15 delivery at $275-$277 a tonne, cost-and-freight Taiwan.
